title: Ginkgo biloba essential oil for medicinal use
intro: Ginkgo biloba essential oil is a concentrated extract derived from the leaves of the ginkgo tree, known for its potent aromatic and therapeutic properties. It is commonly used in herbalism to enhance cognitive function, improve circulation, and support mental clarity. The oil is often diffused to promote focus and reduce stress, or applied topically to alleviate symptoms of poor circulation. It is valued for its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a popular choice in aromatherapy and natural medicine. However, it should be used with caution and diluted properly due to its strong nature.
